## What changed?

Describe the user task or accessibility barrier addressed.

## Control boundary

What can now happen, and what explicitly cannot happen? List permission, application focus and target-selection implications.

## Verification

- [ ] Safe tests have been run without submitting live Codex turns
- [ ] New behaviour has a bounded failure case or recovery test
- [ ] No owner-specific credentials, sessions, screenshots or profiles were committed
- [ ] Existing TV and Codex baselines remain reproducible
- [ ] Any hardware-only or manual acceptance checks are labelled as such

## Remaining limitations

State what is still unverified. Do not claim feature or accessibility conformance without matching evidence.
